{{Quote|Fluggy will undergo the procedure tomorrow and should be back at practice with the team in five or six days, ''[&hellip;]'' His original arm will likely be donated to the hi-lo hall of fame.|Guire Sleazebaggano|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|sports/13411_2.html|Flugg Opts for New Arm}}</ref>}}
'''Guire Sleazebaggano''' was,<ref name="HNN" /> during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|sports/13411_2.html|Flugg Opts for New Arm}} is set on the date 13:4:11, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[hi-lo ball]] player [[Garcy Flugg]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], after Flugg missed fifteen matches in two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] due to chronic [[Limb/Legends|elbow]] injuries, the athlete made the decision to replace his injured [[Limb/Legends|arm]] with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|mechanical]] one. Sleazebaggano made the matter known the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before Flugg's operation, predicted that he would be pack at his team's practices within five to six days, and stated his original arm would likely be donated to the [[hi-lo hall of fame]]. The agent's statement was relayed by an edition of [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition]], reporting out of<ref name="HNN" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Ariana]]<ref name="HNN" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> [[Garos IV]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guire Sleazebaggano was mentioned in "Flugg Opts for New Arm," an article published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #51]] on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="HNN" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]],<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="Release">{{Hnn|51||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #51}}</ref>
